text: dsh-macos-calendar 是面向 DSH Web 宿主的 macOS 日历工具插件，通过注册 DSH 工具调用系统 Calendar 应用。它能列出日历名称、创建带标题和起止时间的事件、附加备注和提前提醒、查询未来事件，也可按标题删除事件并用起始时间缩小范围。日期采用 YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM 格式，默认使用第一个日历。适合希望在 DSH 会话中直接查看和维护 Mac 日程的用户；运行需要 macOS Calendar、osascript 和宿主进程的自动化权限。代码未配置 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-macos-calendar connects DSH Web agents to macOS Calendar. Its tools list calendars, create events with times, notes and reminders, query upcoming events, and delete title-matched events. It uses local macOS automation; no API key or external service is configured.
想让 DSH 帮我查看 Mac 日历接下来几天的安排
能不能在 DSH 对话里直接创建带提醒的日程事件？
I want to add or find events in my Mac Calendar from a DSH session.
dsh-macos-calendar 的功能「日历事件管理」：通过 DSH 工具创建带标题、起止时间、备注和提前提醒的系统日历事件，也可查询未来事件或按标题删除；可指定日历与删除起始时间。
dsh-macos-calendar 的功能「选择日历」：调用只读工具列出 macOS Calendar 中的日历名称，随后创建或查询事件时可指定名称；不指定时使用第一个日历。
dsh-macos-calendar 提供工具 calendar_list：List the names of all calendars in the macOS Calendar app (e.g. Home, Family, Work). Read-only. Use before calendar_add to pick the right calendar name.

dsh-macos-calendar 提供工具 calendar_add：Create an event in the macOS Calendar app. Args: title (required), start and end as "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM" (required, 24h), calendar (optional name, e.g. "Family"; defaults to the first calendar), notes (optional), alert_minutes (optional, reminder minutes before). Returns the created event summary and start time.

dsh-macos-calendar 提供工具 calendar_delete：Delete events in the macOS Calendar app whose summary contains the given title. Args: title (required), calendar (optional name; default first calendar), from (optional "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM", only delete events starting at or after this time — always pass from when possible to avoid deleting old events). Returns the number deleted.
dsh-macos-calendar 提供工具 calendar_events：List events in the macOS Calendar app for the next N days (default 7). Args: calendar (optional name), days (optional, 1-90). Read-only.

dsh-macos-calendar README · dsh-macos-calendar：A host-side plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that gives agents real
**macOS Calendar** integration: create, list, query and delete events in the
Apple Calendar app through AppleScript (EventKit automation).

Unlike in-GUI calendar plugins (e.g. MAGMA27/dsh-calendar, which schedules
Agent runs inside the DSH web UI), this plugin writes **real system calendar
events** — they sync to iCloud and appear in Calendar on all your devices.

dsh-macos-calendar README · Tools：| Tool | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `calendar_list` | List all calendar names (read-only) |
| `calendar_add` | Create an event: title, start/end `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM`, calendar, notes, alert_minutes |
| `calendar_events` | List events of a calendar for the next N days (read-only) |
| `calendar_delete` | Delete events whose summary contains a title (pass `from` to protect old events) |

dsh-macos-calendar README · Tools：Usage in any DSH session: just ask "add a calendar event on ..." — the agent
calls the tools directly. The tools run inside the dsh web host process, so no
per-session approval is needed once the macOS automation permission is granted.

dsh-macos-calendar README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-macos-calendar

dsh-macos-calendar README · restart dsh web：```

Requires Node >= 22, macOS, and Automation permission for the host process
(System Settings → Privacy & Security → Automation → allow the dsh host to
control Calendar). The permission prompt appears on the first osascript call.

dsh-macos-calendar README · Notes for plugin authors (Cordis 4)：This plugin consumed `ctx.tools` and initially crashed the whole dsh web with
`cannot get property "tools" without inject` (231 crash-loop restarts). Cordis 4
requires every consumed service to be declared:

```js
export const inject = ['tools']   // module export form
apply.inject = ['tools']          // function-property form (loader reads this)
```

Keep **both** forms so the include loader resolves the dependency regardless of
which form it reads.

dsh-macos-calendar README · Notes for plugin authors (Cordis 4)：AppleScript date strings depend on the system locale (an ISO string was parsed
as year 12194 in testing) — always construct dates via **date components**
(`set year/month/day/hours/minutes of d to ...`), which is locale-independent.

dsh-macos-calendar README · Development：```sh
npm test            # unit tests (node:test, zero deps)
```

See [TROUBLESHOOTING.md](TROUBLESHOOTING.md) for permission and osascript
failure diagnosis.
